Clinical Encounters

This section contains detailed records of all medical appointments, hospital visits, and clinical consultations.

Subsections

  • Oncology Visits — Regular cancer treatment appointments
  • Hospital Admissions — Inpatient encounters
  • Specialist Consultations — Specialist evaluations and recommendations
  • Imaging Studies — Procedures for diagnostic imaging
  • Procedures — Medical and surgical procedures

Organization

Encounters are organized chronologically. Each encounter includes:

  • Date and time
  • Facility and provider
  • Chief complaint or reason for visit
  • Vital signs
  • Assessment and plan
  • Follow-up recommendations

Individual encounter records are available in the subdirectories.

item.title: Medical Timeline
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Chronological view of all medical events and encounters
item.content:encoded:
Chronological Medical Timeline

This page provides a chronological overview of significant medical events from diagnosis through present.

November 2023: Initial diagnosis with Stage IV colorectal cancer and liver metastases

December 2023 - January 2024: Baseline imaging, staging workup, and treatment planning

January 2024 - Present: Ongoing systemic chemotherapy (FOLFIRI + Bevacizumab) with periodic imaging assessments

See the Clinical Encounters section for detailed notes from individual appointments.

Key Events

  • November 8, 2023 — Pathology confirming adenocarcinoma
  • November 15, 2023 — Oncology consultation and stage IV diagnosis
  • December 2023 — CT chest/abdomen/pelvis staging
  • January 2024 — Treatment initiation with FOLFIRI protocol
  • Ongoing — Monthly follow-up appointments and imaging

For detailed timeline data and visualization, see the complete Clinical Notes and Lab Trends.
